task: 3.3 — Select model settings and calibrate scores

rule: maximise validation average precision (scikit-learn step-wise PR-AUC) over scorable user-hours
ties: fewer parameters, then shorter maximum sequence length, then aggregation order ['max_chunk_mean', 'max_event', 'hour_mean']
selection.threshold_rule: maximise validation F1 of score >= threshold on calibrated scores; ties keep the higher threshold
selection.evaluation_unit: (acting_user, hour_start) user-hour; positive if any deduplicated validation red-team label (source user) falls in it

calibration.reference_description: all 3,745,355 available validation user-hours (days 8-16), label-free, max_event raw scores
calibration.clipping: scores below the lowest reference knot are clipped to 0; the tail approaches but never reaches 1
